top_signals.title: Central Bankers Don’t Work for Presidents
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Opinion columnist Daniel Moss says central banks need enough independence to make painful economic decisions, but autonomy cannot mean freedom from consequences. They ultimately answer to the public, not one president. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japanese lawmakers visit China to patch up ties
top_signals.summary: The group is expected to meet with senior officials of the Chinese Communist Party in the first such exchange since Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi made remarks that angered Beijing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
